children: Liu Chitung, an officer serving as CFO & SVP, reported direct sales of common shares on September 16–17, 2026. The two transactions disposed of 1,600,000 shares at prices of NT$142.333 and NT$145.00 per share, with a weighted average price of approximately NT$142.89. The total sale amount reported was $228,799,600. Following the transactions, Liu Chitung directly owns 2,639,757 common shares and indirectly owns 1,150,000 common shares held in trust or by spouse. The filing notes that amounts are in New Taiwan Dollars, that 1,126,840 of the directly held shares are Restricted Stock Awards with annual vesting through December 5, 2029, and that the indirect holdings are under a trust with discretion reserved.
